en.seo.default_description: Tal Oren and Shahar Naor help business owners find their story, become visible and grow, with a partner beside them every week.
en.home.hero.title: Success is Beautiful
en.home.hero.subtitle: You're good at what you do. We find the story only you can tell, build what makes it visible, and stay beside you until it works.
en.home.mirror.title: Sound familiar?
en.home.mirror.1: Same loop. Every month looks like the last.
en.home.mirror.2: A ceiling you can feel but can't name.
en.home.mirror.3: You know you need to move. You don't know the first step.
en.home.mirror.4: Nobody sees the whole picture of your business. Only you.
en.home.mirror.5: AI is everywhere, and you feel like a deer in the headlights.
en.home.flip.title: We turn the light around.
en.home.flip.body: Instead of you staring into the glare, the light lands on you, and on what makes your business worth choosing.
en.home.flip.ladder_intro: What changes, in the order you'll feel it:
en.home.doors.title: Two doors. One method.
en.home.doors.story_for: For businesses and people who already exist, online or not, and can't yet say what makes them different.
en.home.doors.launch_for: For new businesses, or ones relaunching, that need the whole path in the right order.
en.home.how.title: How it works
en.home.how.1_body: Five minutes. A free, personal snapshot of where your business stands.
en.home.how.2_body: A paid session with both of us. You leave with a written action plan.
en.home.how.3_body: A Story Sprint, a Launch Build, or a three-to-six-month Partnership.

en.home.us.title: Two partners. Both in the room.

en.home.us.shahar: Shahar Naor has spent two decades in design, motion, development and strategy. He ran a design studio for 12 years, founded an ad-tech startup, and builds with AI every day.
en.home.partnership.title: The Partnership
en.home.partnership.body: Three to six months. A weekly meeting with both of us. A system for marketing, sales and operations, built around your story and handed over running.
en.home.faq.title: Questions
en.home.faq.a1: Every path starts with a Clarity Session at {price_session}. If you continue with us, the fee is credited.
en.home.faq.q2: How much of my time will it take?
en.home.faq.a2: One weekly meeting, plus the tasks we agree on together. We carry the heavy lifting; you make the decisions.
en.home.faq.q3: I already have an agency. Why you?
en.home.faq.a3: Keep your agency. We start with who you are and what your business is for, then make sure everyone works from the same story.
en.home.faq.a4: Partly. We support you personally, but we also build: strategy, brand, website, funnel and content.
en.home.faq.a5: We use it and build with it every day. We'll show you where it helps your business and where it doesn't.
en.home.faq.q6: Do you work with larger companies?
en.home.faq.a6: Yes, from Amdocs to Maccabi. See For brands and teams.
en.home.final.title: Ready to step into the light?
en.home.final.body: Start with five minutes. You'll get a personal snapshot whether or not you work with us.

en.about.hero.subtitle: One of us finds the story. The other builds what makes it visible. Both of us stay.
en.about.tal.name: Tal Oren
en.about.tal.body1: Tal has spent more than a decade building and launching brands, alongside CEOs and leadership teams at local and international companies, and with owners starting from one.
en.about.tal.body2: He created BRAND YOURSELF, a ten-step method for finding a business's DNA, which more than a thousand people have bought.
en.about.tal.clients: Worked with L'Oréal, Wella, Mercedes, Amdocs, Maccabi, Mizrahi-Tefahot, Osem and Castro, and with people such as Yitzhak Tshuva, Gil Shwed, Rita, Alon Ulman and Doron Sheffer.
en.about.shahar.name: Shahar Naor
en.about.shahar.body1: Shahar has spent two decades in design, motion, development and strategy. He co-ran the Kapara design studio for 12 years and founded the ad-tech startup Cronus Media.
en.about.shahar.body2: He animated Pale Force for NBC's Late Night with Conan O'Brien, designed for Coca-Cola Israel, and took tech startups from scratch to exit. Today he builds AI tools and works hands-on with founders.
en.about.why.title: Why we joined forces
en.about.why.body: Business owners don't need another supplier. They need someone who sees the whole picture, and then builds it with them. Between us, we cover both.
en.about.promise.title: What we promise
en.about.promise.1: We'll want to understand everything you're going through.
en.about.promise.2: We'll be hands-on, all the way.
en.about.promise.3: You'll always know you're safe, on the right track, with the right partner.
